description: The Bump Chart is designed to show how rankings change over time. It's perfect for visualizing sports standings, market share shifts, or popularity trends. It automatically calculates ranks based on your metric values. It offers smooth curve transitions for clear rank tracking and includes customizable line styles and markers. The visual features integrated ranking logic and full support for small multiples to analyze multiple categories simultaneously.
